summary: A ground-mounted photovoltaic table: ten 1.0 x 1.7 m framed panels in two portrait rows on rails and rafters… joints tilt; options cells, frame; sockets socket_combiner.
setup: Spawn it with Prefabs.solar_panel_array or place "prefab": "solar_panel_array" in a scene; Game(plugins=[...]) needs physics3d().
